acl_entries.description: List of principals allowed to propagate the KDC database to this slave KDC, with optional permissions.

principal.description: Kerberos principal allowed to sync (e.g., kprop/admin@EXAMPLE.COM). Required.

permissions.description: Permission flags (e.g., 'r' for read-only). If omitted, full permissions are granted. For slave KDCs, 'r' is recommended.
